test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six employees of a company are sitting around a table to discuss a project and are facing the centre of the circle. Divya is between Praveen and Suraj. Pavani is between Mukund and Lokesh. Praveen and Mukund are opposite to each other. Suraj is sitting to the right of Mukund. Who is sitting to the right of Praveen?
solution:
According to the given information :

Six employees of a company are sitting around a table to discuss a project and are facing the centre of the circle.

1. Suraj is sitting to the right of Mukund.

2. Praveen and Mukund are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a12a6f2179858f714dbdd96f4dc7c8f5983b164f6b4305ffacac4d89a3262fbf.png] 

3. Divya is between Praveen and Suraj.

4. Pavani is between Mukund and Lokesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05fa96ad8fdb2a9afd32c920ea82549d151139dcaceff3533937c32724dc8c05.png] 

So,** Lokesh is siting to the right of Praveen.**

Hence,** "Lokesh" **is the correct answer.
